question: The 19th Asian Games were held in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **19th Asian Games** were held in the year **2023**. 
• Originally scheduled for **2022**, the event was postponed to **2023** due to the **COVID-19 pandemic** and its global impacts. 
• The **19th edition** of the Asian Games took place in **Hangzhou, China**. 
• The official dates for the event were from **September 23 to October 8, 2023**. 
• The **Asian Games**, also known as the **Asiad**, is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
